name: Sleeping Unicorn
description: Sleeping Unicorn is an online game that is free to play. The objective of the game is to help the sleeping unicorn wake up by collecting pillows and avoiding obstacles. Our new sleeping unicorn game is the perfect way to wind down and relax. It's free to play and you can enjoy it for as long as you like. If you're looking for a fun, easygoing game that you can escape into, this is it!
